tanvi (sec): Heads up — after last-night's RBAC prune, some tenants saw SCIM deprov -> 403s. Possible KMS context mismatch?
ashley (eng): saw alerts. Which tenants? sample log?
sam (sre): pulling logs... snippet:
```
2026-02-07T02:58:12Z identity ERROR scim deprovision extid=acme|U-999 -> 403
2026-02-07T02:58:12Z identity WARN kms unwrap failed: DecryptionError: encryption_context_mismatch expected={"role_hash":"r_old"} got={"role_hash":"r_new"}
```
david (idp): we normalized role slugs in migration (lowercase+trim) which changed role_hash for several roles. KMS context included that hash.
tanvi (sec): impact count?
sam (sre): 10 failed deprovisions across acme/bluelab/northwind in last hour. No outage but deprovisions stuck.
ashley (eng): plan: targeted rewrap of affected extids. @david can you run dry-run then small canary?
david (idp): yes. tool: `python tools/identity_rewrap.py --tenant acme --dry-run --batch 100` did dry-run -> 14 candidates. I'll rewrap 50 now during low traffic.
sre-bot: starting job identity-rewrap-runner canary
okta-bot: event: user=U-999 group_remove=admins
sam (sre): canary finished: 14 rewrapped, 0 failed. SCIM queue drained for acme.
tanvi (sec): create audit entry + add reversible pause if >5% errors. Also open tech-debt to stop including mutable role_hash in KMS context.
david (idp): ticket IDP-734 opened to use immutable role_id in envelope. I'll add runbook notes.
ashley (eng): postmortem note: root cause RBAC canonicalization change + KMS envelope dependency; mitigation rewrap automation + runbook.
tanvi (sec): thanks, closing loop. :thumbsup:
